section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: 2.8.2 The State/UT-wise distribution of suicide victims by Marital Status are presented in Table-24. It is observed that 65.6 percent of victims in Nagaland were unmarried against 22 percent at National level. While only 2.5 per cent of victims in Mizoram were married against the national average of 69 per cent. Chart-2.8 2.9 EDUCATIONAL STATUS OF SUICIDE VICTIMS
